app.title: Polyglot
app.tagline: Learn a new language, a few minutes a day.
sample.notice: You are looking at sample information created for testing. None of it is real, and you can delete it at any time.
error.ownerMissing: We need to know whose information to show.
error.textTooLong: That note is too long. Please shorten it.
error.saveFailed: That information could not be saved. Please try again.
error.saveUnconfirmed: We could not confirm this save. Check your information before trying again.
error.storageUnreadable: This app’s information is in an unexpected state, so nothing was changed.
error.pictureType: That file is not a picture this app can keep. Try a JPG or PNG picture.
error.pictureUnreadable: This picture could not be opened here. Try a JPG or PNG picture.
error.fileRoom: There is not enough room on this computer to keep that file. Make some room and try again.
error.fileNotKept: That file could not be kept. Please try again.
error.fileMissing: That file is no longer here. Choose it again.
error.fileKind: That file is not the kind this place takes.
ai.paused: AI is paused for this app. You can turn it back on in Tellop.
ai.openTellop: Open Tellop to allow AI for this app.
ai.needsPermission: Allow AI for this app in Tellop, then try again.
ai.signedOut: Sign in to Tellop to use AI in this app.
ai.accountChanged: Another account is signed in to Tellop. Turn this app off and on again to use AI.
ai.allowance: Your AI allowance is used up for now.
ai.busy: AI is busy. Try again in a moment.
ai.offline: AI needs the internet. Check the connection and try again.
ai.refused: AI could not answer this. Try something shorter or simpler.
ai.unavailable: AI is not available right now. Try again later.
ai.notDrawnHere: AI can change only a picture it made in this app.
ai.clipUnreadable: Tellop could not read this recording. Try another one.
ai.voicePaused: Writing speech down is paused for up to an hour after a recording that could not be read. Try again later.
ai.practice: AI works in your app once you put this change in.
ai.appAiOff: Tellop does not offer AI inside apps yet.

menu.label: App menu
table.emptyDescription: Whatever you add shows up here.
table.noMatchDescription: Try fewer words or another filter.
learn.voice.aiLabel: The voice reading aloud here is an AI voice.
learn.voice.macInstead: Your Mac reads aloud instead for now.
learn.voice.notKept: The AI voice read this, but Polyglot could not keep it.
learn.notOffered: This language cannot be opened right now. Choose another language in Settings.
learn.start.title: Welcome · Hoş geldin
learn.start.lead: Learn a new language, a few minutes a day. · Her gün birkaç dakikayla yeni bir dil öğren.
learn.start.learnQuestion: Which language do you want to learn?
learn.start.pickFirst: Choose a language to learn first.
learn.start.later: You can change both later in Settings.
learn.where.testLead: A short test suggests where to start in {language}. It takes about 5 to 10 minutes.
learn.where.beginLead: New to this language? Start with the first lesson.
learn.today.title: Today
learn.today.planDone: Today's plan is done. Well done! You can do one more lesson if you like.
learn.today.freeDay: Today is a free day. You can still study if you like.
learn.today.allDone: You finished every lesson. Keep your words fresh with the word cards.
learn.week.title: This week
learn.week.progress: {studied} of {planned} study days done this week
learn.week.noReminder: This app sends no reminders. Open it on your study days.
learn.lessons.title: {language} lessons
learn.lessons.lead: Two levels, twelve units, four lessons in each. Every lesson is open.
learn.lesson.leaveLead: Your answers in this lesson are not saved.
learn.lesson.score: {right} of {total} right on the first try
learn.lesson.addedCards: These words are now in your word cards:
learn.ex.listen-choose: Listen and choose what you hear
learn.ex.article: Right! Learn it with its article:
learn.ex.notThatSentence: That didn't sound like the sentence.
learn.speak.noMicrophone: Polyglot cannot reach a microphone. In Tellop, turn on "Use camera and devices" for this app.
learn.speak.notAllowed: The microphone isn't allowed. Allow it for Tellop in your Mac's Privacy & Security settings, then try again.
learn.speak.cannotRecord: Recording could not start. Try again.
learn.speak.nothingHeard: Nothing was heard. Speak a little louder and try again.
learn.test.title: Level test
learn.test.lead: You see one question at a time. Choose an answer, or press “I don't know”. The test stops early when the first part is hard for you.
learn.test.notExam: This test only suggests where to start in this app. It is not an exam and gives no certificate.
learn.test.startA2: Start at A2. You already know the A1 basics.
learn.test.beyond: This course may be easy for you. Start at A2 to review, and try Practice with AI.
learn.cards.title: {language} word cards
learn.cards.lead: Each word comes back on the right day: soon while it is new, later when you know it well.
learn.cards.doneForToday: You reviewed enough cards for today. The rest come back tomorrow.
learn.cards.noneYet: No cards yet. Finish a lesson, or add your own word.
learn.cards.nextReview: Nothing to review today. Next: {day}, {count} cards.
learn.cards.removeLesson: This card comes back if you do its lesson again, starting fresh.
learn.cards.removeOwn: This is your own word. It cannot be brought back.
learn.cards.emptyLead: Words from your lessons and your own words show up here.
learn.own.title: Your own word
learn.own.lead: It joins your cards today and comes back like the others.
learn.own.front: Word or phrase in the language you learn
learn.review.title: Review
learn.review.practiceLead: Ten cards at random. This practice does not change when your cards come back.
learn.review.nothing: There are no cards to review now.
learn.practice.title: Practice {language} with AI
learn.practice.lead: Check a sentence, ask a question, or talk in writing.
learn.practice.mayBeWrong: Answers come from AI and can be wrong. Nothing on this page is saved.
learn.practice.notSaved: The talk is not saved. Leaving this page forgets it.
learn.practice.unreadable: The AI answer could not be read. Try again.
learn.settings.title: Settings
learn.settings.myLanguage: Your language (for the screens and the meanings)
learn.settings.ownIsCourse: You are learning {language}, so it cannot be your language here. To change it, first choose another language to learn.
learn.settings.eachOwnProgress: Each language keeps its own lessons, cards and study days.
learn.settings.planLead: Choose the days you study and how much. Today's plan follows these.
learn.settings.oneDayLeft: Keep at least one study day.
learn.settings.cardsPerDay: Cards to review in a day
learn.settings.voiceLead: Words are read aloud with your Mac's own voices. Nothing leaves your Mac.
learn.settings.readWithLead.ai: A natural voice for every language. It uses your AI allowance in Tellop, and each text is read by AI only once, then kept.
learn.settings.readWithLead.mac: Free, and nothing leaves this Mac. Some languages may have no voice on this Mac.
learn.settings.speakingLead: Each lesson asks you to say one sentence aloud. AI writes down what you say, on your AI allowance in Tellop. You can always skip it.
learn.settings.speakingSwitch: Ask me to speak in lessons
learn.settings.noVoice: Your Mac has no voice for this language. You can add one in your Mac's settings, under Accessibility, Spoken Content.
learn.settings.levelNone: You have not chosen where to start yet.
learn.settings.startOverLead: This removes this language's lesson results, word cards and study days. Your other languages stay.
learn.settings.startOverWarn: Every lesson result, word card and study day of this language goes. This cannot be undone.
learn.refused.request: That request could not be read. Try again.
learn.refused.long: That is too long. Make it shorter.
learn.refused.language: Choose Turkish or English as your language.
learn.refused.course: That language cannot be learned here. Choose another one.
learn.refused.notStarted: Choose your languages on the Today page first.
learn.refused.switched: This page was for another language. Open it again from the menu.
learn.refused.studyDays: Choose at least one study day.
learn.refused.setting: That setting is not one of the choices.
learn.refused.score: That result does not fit the lesson. Do the lesson again.
learn.refused.card: That card is not here, or it is not due yet.
learn.refused.front: Write the word on one line, in at most 80 characters.
learn.refused.back: Write the meaning on one line, in at most 120 characters.
learn.refused.note: The note can have at most 200 characters.
learn.refused.tooManyCards: You have 2,000 words of your own in this language. Remove some to add more.
learn.refused.test: That test could not be counted. Start the test again.
learn.refused.practice: Write something first, and keep it short.
learn.refused.clock: This Mac's date looks wrong. Check the date and try again.
learn.refused.sounds: Polyglot keeps at most 1,000 AI readings of other texts for this language.
